skill.name: xhs-content-research
skill.description: Research Xiaohongshu content through SocialDataX keyword searches, filtered samples, and evidence-based topic comparisons.
skill.summary: Find XHS content samples and organize traceable insights for creators, content teams, and brand researchers.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Forty static findings are false positives involving Markdown syntax, service links, documented authentication, or readable multilingual text. One finding confirms execution of an unpinned npm package; a separate semantic finding concerns mandatory sharing of token-bearing result URLs. No evidence found of audit manipulation, encoded payloads, or API-key exfiltration in the two supplied files; external package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain installation approval before executing it with access to environment credentials.

remediation.issue: Result URL instructions forbid redacting xsec_token during display, storage, or forwarding.
remediation.suggestion: Keep full URLs only where required for authorized retrieval. Allow redaction in shared reports and explain token scope and sensitivity.

content.user_title: Research Xiaohongshu Content and Topic Samples
content.value_statement: Content teams need traceable samples before choosing topics or comparing competitors. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and separates observed evidence from content recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide keyword searches through the SocialDataX CLI or the xhs_search_notes MCP tool.
Apply sorting, content-type filters, and publication-time filters supported by the search interface.
Limit CLI searches by pages, item counts, and recent publication days.
Continue matching searches with opaque pagination cursors and recover partial results within original limits.
Organize returned titles, authors, links, or identifiers into traceable research samples.
Separate visible evidence from judgments about topic patterns, content angles, and creator positioning.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access, a configured API key, and sufficient service balance; CLI use also requires Node.js and npm.
The supplied files contain instructions and interface metadata, not the external CLI implementation or an MCP server.
Returned pages are samples, not complete platform coverage; recent-day filtering depends on available publication timestamps.
Documents read-only searches, not login or account actions; unpinned package execution and token-sharing guidance require security review.

use_cases.title: Explore New Content Angles
use_cases.description: Collect focused keyword samples and identify evidence-backed angles for a new content series.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Messaging
use_cases.description: Compare returned competitor samples by topic, creator positioning, and visible audience feedback.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Weekly Topic Brief
use_cases.description: Review recent samples within explicit page limits and organize findings for an editorial planning meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a First Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Find one page of Xiaohongshu results for [keyword]. List returned titles and authors, then separate observations from suggested content angles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect a small search sample.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent Topics
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] from the last seven days using the CLI, capped at three pages. Report available publication evidence and coverage limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: apply time filters and sampling limits.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [brand A] and [brand B] with matching filters and a maximum of 20 results each. Distinguish returned evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Interrupted Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [query] using its saved cursor and original filters. Deduct collected pages and items from original limits, preserve partial results, and report gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a bounded research workflow.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative research brief for a one-page search about compact home offices.
output: Illustrative format only: no live search was performed.
Sample evidence: list each returned title, author, and content identifier.
Interpretation: group supported themes separately from proposed content angles.
Coverage: one result page cannot establish platform-wide trends.

output_examples.input: Show an illustrative status report when a three-page search stops after two pages.
output: Illustrative recovery status: two pages collected; results remain incomplete.
Keep collected items and the original error.
After resolving the error, continue with the returned cursor and matching filters for the remaining page.
If the cursor is empty, report the interruption instead of automatically restarting.

best_practices: Start with one page and define page or item limits before expanding a search.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI release and keep API keys in environment configuration rather than prompts or reports.
Separate evidence from inference, state sampling limits, and review token-bearing URLs before sharing results.
anti_patterns: Treating a limited search sample as complete Xiaohongshu coverage or proof of a platform-wide trend.
Changing query filters while reusing an old cursor, or restarting partial searches without adjusting remaining limits.
Executing an unreviewed latest package or distributing token-bearing URLs without checking authorization and sensitivity.

faq.question: What platforms does this skill research?
faq.answer: It focuses on Xiaohongshu, also called XHS or RedNote, through the documented SocialDataX search interfaces.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and service access. The preferred CLI requires Node.js and npm; the MCP alternative requires an available xhs_search_notes tool.

faq.question: Can it publish posts or modify accounts?
faq.answer: The supplied instructions document read-only searches. They do not provide login, posting, liking, commenting, or account-modification workflows.

faq.question: Does it provide complete trend coverage?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on keywords, filters, returned pages, and available publication timestamps. Conclusions must state those limits.

faq.question: How should interrupted searches be resumed?
faq.answer: Preserve collected items and errors. Continue only with a nonempty returned cursor, unchanged filters, and remaining page or item limits.

faq.question: What security precautions matter?
faq.answer: Review and pin the CLI dependency, protect API keys, and assess token-bearing URLs before sharing. The external package implementation was not audited.
